title: 第六章 这是荣耀，而非屈辱
slug: 神印我魔族太女重铸魔族
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

先前枫溪的长篇大论都没触碰到魔神皇枫秀的底线。

原因很简单，因为她先前的那番话是没戳到魔神皇枫秀的伤口。

如今，这几句话就不同了。

白玥的过去是魔神皇枫秀一辈子愧疚的事情。

他辜负了白玲轩，也对不起白玥。

如果他能更早的找到白玥，那么白玥就不用承受这些了。

说白了，都是他来的太晚了。

所以，当白玥用怨恨的眼神看着魔神皇枫秀的时候，他是充满愧疚的。

他对不起白玥和白玲轩，承受白玥的怨恨目光，那是很正常的。

他无法释怀自己的姗姗来迟。

但凡他能在重伤的期间找到白玲轩，白玥也不至于成为一个废人。

“好的，我滚。”

枫溪察觉到自己父皇话语之中的怒火，当即话锋一转，“父皇，请您相信儿臣。”

“我对于白玥姐是没有任何敌意的。相反的，我想跟她好好的相处。”

“父女亲情指望不少，姊妹之情却可以化解她心中的冰冷。”

“她拒绝您的靠近，是因为她怨恨您。今日中我和她的相处时可以看出来，她不排斥我和阿宝。”

说来也搞笑，魔神皇枫秀一心想要弥补着的白玥很讨厌他。

反倒是魔神皇枫秀不太在意的子女们不受白玥的厌恶。

相反的，白玥还愿意跟他们说话。

这现实在枫溪看来是很讽刺的。

这只能说明魔神皇枫秀是活该的。

“……”

魔神皇枫秀唇角上扬着，庞大的压力直接朝着枫溪而来。

“枫溪，不要让本皇再说第二遍。”

他的心情特别的不好。

这个逆女哪壶不开提哪壶！

他算是看明白了。

枫溪这哪里是来诉说自己的委屈，这分明是来跟他炫耀的啊！

魔神皇枫秀真想给枫溪一拳头，让她清醒一点。

“好好好，父皇，儿臣告退了。”

“另外，父皇不用如此小心翼翼。我不在乎长女的名头，我不会对她出手的，她到底是我的姐姐。”

虽然说白玥是她同父异母的姐姐，是一个人魔混血儿，但白玥终究是她的姐姐。

她们到底是姊妹。

别人瞧不起人魔混血儿，那是别人的事情。

枫溪并不认为人魔混血儿一定很低贱。

再说了，那可是她父皇的女儿。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

Fengxi's previous long speech did not touch Demon God Emperor Fengxiu's bottom line.

The reason is simple, because her previous words did not scratch the wound of Demon God Emperor Fengxiu.

Today, these words are different.

Bai Yue's past is something that Demon God Emperor Fengxiu will feel guilty about for the rest of his life.

He failed Bai Lingxuan, and he also failed Bai Yue.

If he could find Bai Yue earlier, then Bai Yue wouldn't have to bear this.

To put it bluntly, he came too late.

Therefore, when Bai Yue looked at Demon God Emperor Fengxiu with resentful eyes, he was full of guilt.

It was normal for him to feel sorry for Bai Yue and Bai Lingxuan and bear Bai Yue's resentful look.

He couldn't let go of his late arrival.

As long as he could find Bai Lingxuan while he was seriously injured, Bai Yue would not become a useless person.

"Okay, I'll get out."

Fengxi noticed the anger in his father's words and immediately changed the subject, "Father, please believe me."

"I have no hostility towards Sister Bai Yue. On the contrary, I want to get along well with her."

"There is a lot of hope in the family relationship between father and daughter, but the love between sisters can resolve the coldness in her heart."

"She refuses your approach because she resents you. When I got along with her today, I can see that she does not reject A Bao and me."

It's funny to say that Bai Yue, who was trying to make amends with Demon God Emperor Fengxiu, hated him.

On the contrary, the children that Demon God Emperor Fengxiu didn't care much about were not disliked by Bai Yue.

On the contrary, Bai Yue was still willing to talk to them.

This reality seems very ironic to Fengxi.

This only shows that Demon God Emperor Fengxiu deserves what he deserves.

"..."

The corners of Demon God Emperor Fengxiu's lips rose, and huge pressure came directly towards Fengxi.

"Fengxi, don't let me say it a second time."

He was in a particularly bad mood.

This rebellious woman can't help but lift any pot!

He finally understood.

Fengxi wasn't here to express his grievances. She was clearly here to show off to him!

Demon God Emperor Fengxiu really wanted to give Fengxi a punch to make her sober up.

"Okay, okay, father, I have resigned."

"Besides, my father doesn't need to be so cautious. I don't care about my eldest daughter's name. I won't take action against her. She is my sister after all."

Although Bai Yue is her half-sister, a human-demon hybrid, Bai Yue is her sister after all.

They are sisters after all.

If others look down on human-demon hybrids, that is their business.

Fengxi doesn't think that human-demon hybrids are necessarily lowly.

Besides, that's her father's daughter.
